constructions.actual_supplied_text: Oath by the common safety/salvation; welfare is an explanatory contextual alternative. hǣle is feminine accusative singular of hǣlu, reusing the older exact source form and safety/rescue sense. No possessive our is printed.

constructions.actual_supplied_text: The service is the means of the benefit; hwilces ... mannes is its genitive dependent. hwæt asks what sort/status of man he is. sīe is the dependent interrogative be form.

constructions.actual_supplied_text: Concessive clause: even if he himself keeps it unspoken. Supply the source forswīge with its present subjunctive interpretation; do not demand a full new weak-verb paradigm.
